scene.emotion: The waiting crowd falls quiet. The three dancers exchange smiles as each arrives.

All three finger hearts land on the last accent.

timeline.framing: Wide, facing the ring of spectators.
timeline.action: Keep the centre of the plaza empty. All three performers remain off screen.

shots.summary: 손끝이 재생 버튼에 닿는 순간 음악이 시작된다.

timeline.framing: Close-up of the triangular play button.
timeline.action: Open on contact. The spectator depresses the button and lifts their fingertip.

shots.summary: 서린의 독무에 마이안과 투비가 차례로 합류하고 마지막 박에 셋이 손하트를 만든다.

timeline.framing: Front-facing full-body view of the plaza.
timeline.action: Seorin steps in from the planter and dances solo. Keep this angle and the dancers' feet in frame through the final pose.

images.cue: Mai An joins Seorin from the left without breaking step.
Tu Vi enters from the right. All three continue the same phrase.
Hold the three finger hearts through the musical tail.
